Consolidated canonical skill. Title: OpenClaw Token Waste Audit. Simplified output to 3 sections. Added bilingual feedback hooks. Removed D1-D10, Safety Contract, Fast/Deep Dive paths, cost breakdown.
Simplified to 3-question format. Renamed to Token Waste Audit. Removed D1-D10, Safety Contract, CLI refs. Read-only default. Added feedback hook.

v1.4.0: Add D10 rule — detect script-wrapper agentTurn jobs (e.g. Health Check, Log Analyzer) that waste tokens by using LLM just to format script output. D10 fires when: agentTurn + model set + message is script path/exec only + summary median ≤50 chars. Add fix: convert to EXEC_SCRIPT type.

v1.3.1: Re-publish with references/ directory included. Fix D8 to use summary field. Add OPENCLAW_HOME env var. English triggers. --cron not --schedule.
